style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot, variant and trust screens; soft sakura pink #FADCE3 for selling and detail screens; pale blue tint #EAF4FB for macro; warm cream #F3E9DC for lifestyle

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sakura pink #FADCE3, rose pink accent #F27E9B, cloud blue #8FCDF0 and charcoal text #3A3A3C on clean white grounds; warm bright studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif; thin rounded-line icon style with numbered circles and dashed-circle badges; clean kidswear photography mixed with minimal infographic tiles; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no third-party character graphics.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment set; folded flat lay for variant and trust screens; consistent scale across the set
